title: CloudSync.syncNow discards cloudRefresh's 'same'. A Sync now inside the 5 s throttle reads nothing and still shows Synced (record-session.ts:452-455, CloudSync.swift:134). Product call for Brad
evidence: Done 2026-11-26 (Brad, option (a)): packages/health-core/src/refresh-pause.ts refreshDue decides; RecordSession.refreshFromRemote(reason) skips the pause for 'pressed'; ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudRefresh passes 'pressed' for both its callers, Sync now and the Apple Health import's re-read after a refused batch (HealthRoadmapApp.swift passes sync.syncNow()), at most once per refused batch (US-34 AC12; limit: two overlapping reads can still end Synced with the newer read dropped until the next). Reaches the iPhone with the next engine release; no Swift change. Pinned by refresh-pause.test.ts, record-session.session.test.ts and ios/engine/cloud.test.ts (H31).
